AC7 complete; pushed for review.

`make verify`: **exit 0, 19,826 passed, 88 skipped, 53:46.** All 7 ACs now pass.

Committed as `d131b3abe9f`, then rebased onto `76a3cbac755` (the WORKFLOWS slice) as `5f874f6a49a40d3b95062082d8b8c6fa8a7c1d15`. The rebase was clean with no conflict — this slice touches only tests and adds no `docs/release-notes.md` entry, which is exactly why it could be pushed in parallel with EVAL while the two release-notes-touching slices were serialized. Diffstat unchanged by the rebase: 4 files, 26 insertions, 26 deletions. `rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev HEAD` → `OK - resolved 8c31-f393-19f1-4da8`.

Pushed as **Gerrit change 3134**.

**Count cross-check against the sibling slice.** This run reported 19,826 passed; the EVAL slice (`ce4f`) reported 19,820 on the same baseline. The difference of exactly 6 is the 6 collected items EVAL removes, which independently confirms this slice removes no tests — the repointed tests are still collected and still asserting. That matches the slice's intent: the coverage moves from `operations._review_ticket_impl` to `spec_scan.scan_epics_for_spec` without changing what is asserted.
